description: This script provides configuration and setup functions for configuring WireGuard VPN interfaces within a network management system, including key generation, peer setup, and interface configuration commands.

methods.name: proto_wireguard_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the configuration options for a WireGuard interface, including private key, listen port, MTU, and firewall mark.

methods.name: proto_wireguard_setup_peer
methods.description: Configures a WireGuard peer based on provided peer configuration data, handling peer details such as public key, endpoint, allowed IPs, and optional preshared key.

methods.name: ensure_key_is_generated
methods.description: Checks if the private key for a specified network interface exists; if marked as 'generate', generates a new key and updates the UCI configuration.

methods.name: proto_wireguard_setup
methods.description: Sets up a WireGuard interface with specified configuration, including interface keys, IP addresses, and peer configurations, then applies the configuration.
